name: ProGuides Valorant
noteEs: Canal dedicado a coaching estructurado de Valorant. ProGuides Valorant produce guías de agente, tier lists, análisis de patches y entrevistas con pros (Sentinels Kaplan, etc.). Su contenido tiene production value alto y enfoque pedagógico — más para players que quieren aprender técnica formal que para entretenimiento puro.
noteEn: Channel dedicated to structured Valorant coaching. ProGuides Valorant produces agent guides, tier lists, patch analysis, and pro interviews (Sentinels Kaplan, etc.). The content has high production value and pedagogical focus — more for players who want to learn formal technique than for pure entertainment.
highlightsEs: Guías por agente con tutoriales de mecánica y mid-game decisions
Tier lists actualizadas por patch con context editorial
Entrevistas con pros y coaches enfocadas en aprendizaje
Tutoriales de tech avanzada (movement, abilities tricks)
highlightsEn: Per-agent guides with mechanics and mid-game decision tutorials
Patch-updated tier lists with editorial context
Pro and coach interviews focused on learning
